text: DSH Bookmarks Custom（DSH 网页插件）：在会话中收藏已完成的 AI 回复，并在主区域面板集中查看。它在每条回复旁提供收藏入口，可为书签添加备注和标签；中心面板支持跨会话浏览、按文本搜索和标签筛选，也能编辑或删除书签、跳回对应会话，并将书签导出为 Markdown 文件。书签由 DSH storage domain 保存，回复摘要从已持久化的会话记录生成。适合需要整理和回顾 DSH 回复的用户。安装到 web profile 后无需额外配置，不需要 API 密钥。

DSH Bookmarks Custom saves assistant replies in DSH. Add notes and tags, browse and search bookmarks across sessions, filter by tag, edit or delete entries, and reopen their sessions. Export the collection as Markdown. Bookmarks use DSH storage; no API key or extra configuration is needed.
想把有用的 AI 回复收藏起来，之后还能加备注和标签。
怎样搜索以前不同会话里保存的回答？
I want to export my saved assistant replies to a Markdown file.
DSH Bookmarks Custom 的功能「逐条收藏回复」：在已完成的助手回复旁点收藏按钮，可创建条目并填写备注和标签；服务端从持久化会话记录生成回复摘要，并保存到书签存储。
DSH Bookmarks Custom 的功能「跨会话书签中心」：从侧栏入口或 Alt+B 打开主区域面板，可搜索书签内容、按标签过滤、编辑备注和标签、删除条目、打开其所属会话，并把收藏内容下载为 Markdown。

dsh-bookmarks README · dsh-bookmarks：[](https://awesome-dsh-plugin.com/) [](https://github.com/penguin-oo/dsh-bookmarks/actions/workflows/ci.yml)

Bookmark assistant replies in [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (DSH) Web UI: bookmark any finalized assistant reply with a note and tags, browse every bookmark from every session in one center panel, and export them to Markdown in one click.

[中文说明](./README.zh.md)
dsh-bookmarks README · This fork：Sanitized snapshot of a locally customized build (`0.1.5-custom.1`). Changes from upstream:

dsh-bookmarks README · This fork：- The center opens as a **main-area panel** (`layout.selectPanel('bookmarks')`) instead of a fixed overlay; `Alt+B`, the sidebar footer entry and jump-back all use the same navigation.
- **Two-column layout**: bookmark list on the left, replies on the right, each column scrolling independently.
- The panel respects the desktop title-bar clearance and fills the main area instead of the viewport.
- Sidebar footer entries are ordered consistently (bookmarks 20, skill-explorer 25, mnemon 30, market 40) through a scoped CSS adapter.
- Personal identifiers and local paths were removed; no bookmark data is included in this repository.
dsh-bookmarks README · This fork：Original project: [penguin-oo/dsh-bookmarks](https://github.com/penguin-oo/dsh-bookmarks) (MIT). The customization is published under the same license.

dsh-bookmarks README · Features：- **Per-message bookmark** — an archive button on each finalized assistant reply (right next to the 👍/👎 feedback buttons), with an inline editor for a note and comma-separated tags.
- **Server-derived snippet** — the bookmark stores a text preview of the actual reply, so the center stays useful even without a note.
- **Cross-session center** — one panel listing bookmarks from all sessions and workspaces, with full-text search, tag filter, inline editing and deletion.
- **Jump back** — every entry opens its session in one click.
- **Markdown export** — one click downloads all bookmarks as `dsh-bookmarks.md`.
- **Keyboard** — `Alt+B` toggles the center from anywhere.
- **Safe writes** — per-item compare-and-set versions (multi-tab safe), server-side validation, and durable storage via the DSH storage domain.

dsh-bookmarks README · Install：```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-bookmarks
```

Then restart DSH (`dsh web`). The plugin appends itself to the profile bundle layer automatically; nothing else to configure.

For a local checkout:

```sh

dsh-bookmarks README · from the plugin repo：dsh plugin --profile web add file:./        # relative file spec, anchored to your cwd
```

dsh-bookmarks README · Config：The bundle row exposes three limits (all optional):

| Key | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `maxNoteBytes` | `4096` | Max UTF-8 bytes of one note (`""` clears a note; omitting the field keeps it). |
| `maxSnippetChars` | `300` | Max characters of the server-derived reply snippet. |
| `maxTags` | `8` | Max tags per bookmark; each tag ≤ 32 chars, trimmed and deduplicated. |

Override them in the profile patch layer (`$DSH_HOME/profiles/web/cordis.patch.yml`):

dsh-bookmarks README · Config：```yaml
- id: bookmarks
  config:
    maxNoteBytes: 2048
    maxSnippetChars: 200

dsh-bookmarks README · How it works：- **Host half** (`lib/index.js`) — the `bookmarks` Remote service (Typert), backed by a storage-domain table (`$DSH_HOME/storages/bookmarks.json`). `put` inspects the persisted session log to validate the target reply and derive its snippet, mirrors the official `message-feedback` durability barrier, and serializes mutations with per-item version tokens.
- **Browser half** (`src/client`, bundled to `lib/client.js`) — mounts the Remote contribution through `ctx.remote.$mount`, then registers two UI slots: `conversation.chat.assistant-actions` (the per-message button) and `sidebar.footer.action` (the center toggle).

dsh-bookmarks README · Development：```sh
npm install            # zod + esbuild (dev only)
npm run build          # bundles src/client into lib/client.js
```

`lib/client.js` is committed and shipped; no build step runs on install.

dsh-bookmarks README · Limitations：- Bookmarks are stored in one global row: fine for personal use, not a shared multi-user store.
- The center panel jumps to the bookmarked *session*; it does not auto-scroll to the exact message yet.
- The panel toggle lives in the sidebar footer; use `Alt+B` when the sidebar is collapsed.
